features_title: Everything a real app needs, nothing it does not

feature_vue_text: Composition API, instant hot reload, lazy loaded routes and small stores for auth and locale.

feature_i18n_text: vue-i18n with lazy loaded locales: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Chinese.
